facts.fact: 有人递上十三世纪中美洲羊皮纸合同，作者说“不必把印加纸扯进来”——Incan paper 谐音“in Cain paper”？实为 inking／incan 双关，指不必要的介入
facts.anchor: I said, ‘We don’t need to bring Incan paper into this!’

facts.fact: 罗马人竖两根手指要五杯啤酒——罗马数字 II 与五的计数法错位
facts.anchor: A Roman walks into a bar, holds up two fingers and says, ‘Five beers please.’

facts.fact: 弗拉德三世（穿刺公）与维尼熊的共同点：中间名相同（都是“the”）
facts.anchor: What do Vlad the Impaler and Winnie the Pooh have in common? The same middle name.

facts.fact: 亚历山大大帝把军队藏在哪儿：slee vies，sleeve（袖子）的儿语化
facts.anchor: Where did Alexander the Great keep his armies? Up his sleevies.

facts.fact: 克利奥帕特拉看见金字塔说“妈妈回家了”——mummy 双关木乃伊／妈妈
facts.anchor: What did Cleopatra say when she saw the pyramids? Mummy’s home!

facts.fact: 路易十四付完凡尔赛宫的钱后破产了：Baroque 谐音 broke
facts.anchor: What was Louis XIV after he paid for the Palace of Versailles? Baroque.

facts.fact: 马克思为什么喝咖啡：all property is theft（一切财产都是盗窃）被换成 proper tea
facts.anchor: Why did Karl Marx drink coffee? Because all proper tea is theft.

facts.fact: 南军知不知道自己在历史错误一边：Not General Lee，谐音 not generally／将军李
facts.anchor: Did the Confederate army in the American Civil War know they were on the wrong side of history? Not General Lee.

facts.fact: 海盗打耳洞收多少钱：a buck an ear，谐音 buccaneer（海盗）
facts.anchor: What do pirates charge for piercings? A buck an ear.

facts.fact: 海盗最爱的字母是 P：没有它海盗就 irate（愤怒），谐音 a pirate
facts.anchor: What’s actually a pirate’s favourite letter? ‘P’: without it, a pirate’s irate!
